# Third-party code

Kept as it came from its author, under its own licence (the licence text is in
each file's header). Nothing here is ours: send a fix to the upstream, or keep
a change marked in the file.

| Folder | What | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `uthash/` | `uthash.h` and `utlist.h`, Troy D. Hanson's hash table and linked list macros, https://troydhanson.github.io/uthash/ | BSD 2-clause |
| `mersenne-twister/` | MT19937 (Matsumoto and Nishimura, 1998), our own implementation: not third-party code | GPL-3.0-or-later |
| `tomlc99/` | Cktan's TOML parser (submodule) | MIT |
| `libmapvxl/` | the previous map library, only `tools/mapbench` builds it as a baseline (submodule; left out of the public server repository) | see the submodule |
